text:
Jia Chen: Quick ping — PR #8247 is blocked on architecture review. It introduces a routing header to let frontends route requests by model variant (quality/cost). RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/8247-routing-header

Maya S: Thanks. Skimmed the RFC. Two quick asks: 1) add a perf regression matrix, 2) clarify fallback behavior when header absent. Also pinging @Samir for arch plateau.

Samir Patel: Happy to take a look later today. Is the fallback just default model route? how does this interact with existing smart-routing policies?

Jia Chen: Fallback is default model route; RFC 'Fallbacks' section added but needs arch sign-off. Local bench (single-node) shows ~3% p99 increase under sustained 2k RPS with config A. I'll upload the full table to the RFC and PR.

Samir Patel: Sounds reasonable. Also propose canary: 1% for 24h -> 10% for 6h -> 100%. Add explicit rollback conditions (error spike, latency > +15% p99).

Jia Chen: Added canary plan and rollback criteria in PR description and RFC under 'Rollout'.

deploy-bot: CI: staging integration tests completed — 33 passed, 2 flaky tests (skipped). See https://ci.redwood/8247

Samir Patel: Unit tests look good. Integration failing on auth token in workspace tests — @Alex R can you re-run with updated creds?

Alex R: pushed a quick fix to test harness and re-ran CI on the branch. All green now.

Maya S: Left one minor comment about TTL semantics on the header; can Jia clarify whether TTL is enforced service-side or left to callers.

Jia Chen: TTL clarification pushed to RFC and PR comment. TTL will be enforced service-side with a max clamp of 24h.

Maya S: Okay — LGTM for architecture. Please ensure rollout is tracked in the release spreadsheet and monitor error budgets closely. :white_check_mark:

Jia Chen: Thanks all — I'll merge once the release coordinator gives the 1% canary slot. Will watch the dashboards and post updates in #incidents if anything odd.

Samir Patel: thx. will follow the canary and ping if we see regressions.

Alex R: noted, will monitor infra alerts during rollout.
